title: Imag-Eval: a language-grounded framework for interpretable Text-to-Image instruction following evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.29210v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text-to-Image (T2I) models have recently achieved impressive visual fidelity, yet their evaluation remains constrained by benchmarks that are often difficult to interpret and insufficiently diagnostic. Existing skill-based evaluations tend to overlook critical failure modes that strongly impact usability but fall outside standard taxonomies, such as global incoherence arising from missing parts or physically implausible configurations (e.g., floating objects). In addition, prompt difficulty is typically controlled along a single dimension; either prompt length or the number of elements to generate. To address these limitations, we introduce Imag-Eval, a controlled benchmark designed to assess how T2I models ground compositional natural-language instructions into visual outputs. translated_title: Imag-Eval：一个基于语言的框架，用于可解释的文本到图像指令遵循评估
translated_abstract: 文本到图像（T2I）模型近来已实现了令人印象深刻的视觉保真度，然而其评估仍然受限于那些往往难以解释且诊断能力不足的基准测试。现有的基于技能的评估往往忽略了那些严重影响可用性但不在标准分类体系内的关键失败模式，例如由缺失部件引起的全局不连贯性，或物理上不合理的配置（例如悬浮的物体）。此外，提示词难度通常仅沿单一维度进行控制，即要么是提示词长度，要么是需生成元素的数量。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了Imag-Eval，这是一个受控基准，旨在评估T2I模型如何将组合性自然语言指令落地为视觉输出。与以往将表面语言复杂性与组合难度混为一谈的工作不同，Imag-Eval明确寻求通过独立……（原文在此处截断）来解开这些因素。
tldr: 提出了Imag-Eval，一个受控基准框架，通过将表面语言复杂性与组合难度解耦，实现对文本到图像模型组合性指令遵循能力的可解释评估，并捕捉传统评估体系忽略的关键失败模式。
en_tdlr: Imag-Eval is a controlled benchmark that disentangles surface linguistic complexity from compositional difficulty to provide interpretable evaluation of text-to-image models' instruction following, capturing critical failure modes overlooked by existing taxonomies.
